entities.summary: Mahmoud Sami Al Baroudi was an Egyptian statesman and prominent poet who served as the fifth Prime Minister of Egypt from 4 February 1882 to 26 May 1882. He was married to a member of the Yeghen family, descendants of Mohammed Ali pashas’s sister.
